gaps.explanation: No business-type detail lines. Proprietary statement p7 (Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Net Position - Proprietary Funds) prints Water Fund, Sewer Fund and Sanitation Fund columns. JSON receipts = Sales + Other revenue (operating) + Interest income + Grant income (nonoperating). Per fund: Water 1,081,497 + 6,519 + 9,832 + 59,755 = 1,157,603; Sewer 1,135,545 + 9,799 + 7,157 = 1,152,501; Sanitation 598,678 + 3,074 + 6,231 = 607,983. Sum 2,918,087 = statement total (2,835,112 + 23,220 + 59,755); 0 + 2,918,087 = 2,918,087, exact.
